meta.title: Regenerate session title
meta.description: Adds a session menu action that regenerates a session title through the official all-prompts title provider, with a fail-closed provider preflight, archive filtering and a blocking confirmation before a manual title is replaced.

ui.toast.noInput: This session has no eligible conversation text; the title was not regenerated.
ui.toast.providerUnavailable: The official all-prompts title provider is unavailable. Enable it and try again.
ui.toast.providerUnavailableRecovered: The official all-prompts title provider is unavailable. Your manual title “{title}” was restored and kept.
ui.toast.providerUnavailableFallback: The official all-prompts title provider is unavailable and the manual title could not be restored: {reason}. The title is still the automatic fallback “{title}”.
ui.toast.providerCheckFailed: Could not confirm the official title provider. Please try again.
ui.toast.archived: This session is archived, so its title was not regenerated.
ui.failure.inputTooLarge: the conversation text is too long for the title provider
ui.failure.invalidOutput: the provider returned an invalid title
ui.failure.superseded: a newer request replaced this one
ui.modal.title: Replace the manual title?
ui.modal.description: This session has the manual title “{title}”. Regenerating replaces it and unpins the manual title.
ui.modal.consequence: The new title comes from the official all-prompts title provider. If generation fails, the title may fall back to an automatic title and cannot be rolled back.
